args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

Here is the note on the PHL label confusion, from Sofia Marchetti's #coastal-team post with Bettina Kroll's addition.

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026.
- "PHL" is now ambiguous: filtering it returns both Pellow Home Living and Pellucid Harbor Logistics.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". Sofia said in February she would relabel the saved retail view, and it has not been changed yet.
- Ask: update the saved report label to Pellow Home Living so the old name stops appearing in search.

Thanks,
Sofia Marchetti and Bettina Kroll (drafted by assistant)
